classification.difficultyReason: Identify the edges of a specified path and subtract their known times from the total to find an unknown weight.

content.prompt:
This weighted graph shows the time taken to walk between five locations, in minutes.
If it takes 59 minutes to walk the path $D\! -\! A\! -\! B\! -\! E$, what is the value of $x$?

spec.description: Five-vertex undirected network. A is upper left, B upper middle-left, C upper right, D lower left and E lower right. All seven source edges and weights are retained. Ordinary source green edges and markers use house black.
spec.mathematics: AB=14, AD=17, BD=22, BC=19, CE=16, DE=35 and BE=x, all in minutes. The specified path is D-A-B-E.
spec.answerVisibility: Only supplied weights and the unknown x are visible.
